gloss: it can't be helped; there's no choice

definitions.gloss: it can't be helped; there's no choice; it's inevitable
definitions.explanation: Expresses resignation or acceptance that nothing can be done about a situation. A very common Japanese expression reflecting acceptance of circumstances.

definitions.gloss: can't help doing; can't stop oneself from
definitions.explanation: When preceded by a verb in て-form, expresses that one cannot help doing something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧なんだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、しかたがない。
examples.english: It's raining, so it can't be helped.

examples.japanese: こう⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまったらしかたがない。
examples.english: Since it's come to this, there's nothing we can do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧しかたがない。⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}おう→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: What's broken is broken. Let's buy a new one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、しかたがない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めた→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Since there was no time, I accepted it and gave up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、しかたがない。⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}ろう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: It's a shame, but it can't be helped. Let's do our best next time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧でしかたがない。
examples.english: I can't help but love her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧しかたがない。
⟦{寂|さび}しくて→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧しかたがなかった。
⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧しかたがない⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧みた。
examples.english: I couldn't stop worrying about it, so I tried calling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{嬉|うれ}しくて→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧しかたがなかった。
examples.english: When I heard I passed, I was so happy I couldn't contain myself.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧ (way, method) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (doesn't exist)
Literally: "there is no way/method"
- しかたがない (standard)
- しかたない (casual, contracted)
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (with kanji)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜てしかたがない = can't help but ~, unbearably ~
  Example: ⟦{寂|さび}しくて→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧しかたがない (unbearably lonely)
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しかたがない (same meaning, after na-adjectives)

CULTURAL NOTE:
This is one of the most important expressions in Japanese culture, reflecting the concept of accepting what cannot be changed. It's not defeatism but rather a form of practical acceptance.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Appropriate in most situations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しょうがない→しょうがない：07381_shouganai⟧ - colloquial/casual equivalent
- ⟦やむを{得|え}ない→やむを得ない：07320_yamuwoenai⟧ - formal equivalent (unavoidable)
- ⟦どうしようもない→どうしようもない：18862_doushiyoumonai⟧ - there's nothing to be done
